source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch moves touch bookkeeping into initialized private class fields and separate private start/end/move methods. ensureInitialized registers those method identities. The field JSDoc uses Map<number, number>, matching the reviewed local type syntax; only the move method has its own event JSDoc. These are accepted local organization and naming facts, not a global private-method, prefix or documentation mandate, and they do not claim implemented listener teardown.
title: The month-view touch handlers keep initialized private state outside view initialization
